transcription.text: Maybe one for William and one for all. Of course, you can all answer. William, how do developers maintain a mental model of the software when patches are coming in from outside engineering? I don't know. I have to say. Personally, I can answer. The code I wrote and the code I still write with AI agents is still the same, exactly as before. We don't have any special tooling around that.

The only thing that maybe we did add, but I don't know if that answers your question about how do the engineers maintain that mental model, but also the agents need to maintain that mental model. So what we specifically do is we run sort of these scanners to our code base and then create these indexes into the knowledge base to kind of try to explain and understand, okay, what is this repo about? Because I did mention we have more than 300 production repositories in our code base. So there's a lot to kind of look into.

a lot of documentation and now that documentation is maintained by AI itself. So we share that documentation. That's also what engineers use. They read that same documentation. It's actually public. So you build up that mental model as you do that, even if you don't write everything online. Thank you.
